plainText:
Jacq (Japanese: ジニア Zinnia) is a character introduced in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. He serves as the biology teacher of Naranja Academy /Uva Academy , as well as the homeroom teacher for the track. Along with the World Pokémon Ecological Society, he is known for his research on convergent species.

==In the core series games==
===Role===
====Pokémon Scarlet and Violet====
Jacq is a biology teacher who works at Naranja Academy /Uva Academy . He is also the 's homeroom teacher, as well as the developer of the Pokédex app for the Rotom Phone. Although he is very well-versed in his field, he is somewhat airheaded, and is sometimes lost in his own research. 

Jacq also participates in the Academy Ace Tournament. Upon the player completing more and more of the Pokédex, he grants them various rewards, culminating in a Shiny Charm after the player has registered all 400 Pokémon entries.

====The Teal Mask====
Jacq is the teacher who informs the player they have been selected to attend the field trip to Kitakami. After the player begins their orienteering activities there, they can find Jacq at Reveler's Road, where he will invite them to a picnic and give them an containing a random Sinnoh first partner Pokémon. Following that, he will remain at Reveler's Road, where he will volunteer to evaluate their Kitakami Pokédex and reward the player with a Glimmering Charm for completing it.

====Other appearances====
Jacq and Professor Willow discussed the Pokémon in a promotional video for Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, uploaded on November 6, 2022. Jacq was the one who named Gimmighoul's . 

===Appearance===
Jacq is a tall man with light tan skin, platinum gray eyes, an average build, and hair with purple and lavender variations. He wears hexagonal glasses around his eyes. His attire features a white lab coat over a shirt with violet and magenta stripes, purple jogging pants, and white slippers with dark magenta straps.

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon GO===
Jacq debuted in on November 5, 2022, immediately following the Community Day Classic event. After the spins a golden PokéStop and obtains a ?????? Coin for the first time, Jacq contacts Professor Willow, and the two discuss the coin together.

===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Jacq forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Jacq became a playable sync pair on March 31, 2024.

==Quotes==
 

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon Horizons: The Series===
Jacq first appeared in Welcome to Naranja Academy!. He was first seen at Naranja Academy, where he met Liko, Roy, and Dot. He requested that while Liko and her friends participate in the Tera Training course, they also take photos and make reports on any wild Pokémon they would encounter while traveling.

Jacq was mentioned by Clavell in Trending Terastallization! Dance, Dance, Quaxly!. During Clavell's assessment of Liko, Roy, and Dot's progress in Tera Training, he mentioned that Jacq saw a lot of potential in the young Trainers.

In Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four, Jacq accompanied Clavell in welcoming the students back to the academy and promising to give each of their reports a good read. He later joined the students in watching the Elite Four Tag Battle.

In Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!, Jacq was asked by Clavell to follow Dot's research and report on Laquium. Intrigued by the subject, he decided to participate in the research alongside the Rising Volt Tacklers.

In Dot and Penny's Top-Secret Mission!, Penny revealed to Dot that she will leave Jacq in charge of researching the data they recovered from the Exceed Museum server.

Days later, in HZ126, Jacq met with Clavell, Geeta, . Penny and the Rising Volt Tacklers to discuss the information Dot and Penny had gathered. While he was concerned about the data, he pointed out that the way the information was collected might prevent public opinion from accepting it naturally.

====Character====
Jacq has a friendly and cheerful personality, and is always keen to help students and encourage them in their endeavors. Jacq's research is considered a benchmark, being used by Briar in Don't Give Up, Crocalor! as a reference to help her understand more about and the Laquium. 

In the past, Jacq was a Pokémon ecology researcher alongside Clavell, but due to Clavell's strictness towards his work, Jacq was often reprimanded.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 ]]
Jacq debuted in Speeding! Paldea's Prince of Speed!!. He was first seen in the Uva Academy staff room, attacking someone he believed to be an intruder, only to find it was a student named Violet. Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, Violet's talking Rotom Phone, Old Roto, asked Jacq to install a Pokédex app onto it, which he accepted. Once Jacq found that Violet was looking through the student registry, he attempted to reprimand the boy, only for Violet to escape. Later, Clavell gathered Jacq and the other teachers in order to inform them of Violet's backstory and explain his behavior.

In Stream! Iono Zone!!, Jacq, along with Salvatore and Raifort, agreed to take Clavell's place in Iono's Gym Test.
 

====Pokémon====
 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Jacq was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese expansion and the English expansion, with artwork by GIDORA. An print illustrated by the same artist, and a version of the card with artwork by Oswaldo KATO were released in the same sets. It lets players search their deck for up to two Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them in their hand. Afterwards, the player shuffles their deck.
 

==Trivia==
Jacq first appeared in Pokémon GO thirteen days before the release of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, thus technically making him the second character to appear in the core series games after first appearing in a spin-off game (the first being Professor Burnet). However, he was first revealed in pre-release material for Pokémon Scarlet and Violet in August 2022, three months prior to his Pokémon GO appearance.
Jacq was intended to speak in the World Pokémon Ecological Society mock seminar that showcased , but he ran late and ended up unable to attend, according to an unnamed assistant. Despite this, Professor Willow mentions Jacq having spoken at the World Pokémon Ecological Society conference. 
In a prior version of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet , if the gift hatched from the from Riley is transferred from Pokémon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl to Pokémon Scarlet or Violet, the game will state it was received from Jacq.
All of Jacq’s Pokémon represent the biomes of Paldea and Kitakami.
Arcanine’s evolutionary line is found in rocky areas.
Lurantis’ evolutionary line is found in forests and meadows.
Swalot’s evolutionary line is found near urban areas.
Mudsdale’s evolutionary line is found in mountains and swamps.
Slowbro’s evolutionary line is found near rivers and beaches.
Farigiraf’s and Victreebel’s evolutionary lines are found in prairies.
Jacq's Japanese name is the same name as Zinnia's English name.
